name: Hansang Korean Family Restaurant
reviews:
Not sure where the negative reviews come from because I've been here 3 times, all with good experiences!

The food is generally very good. My favourites are their stews, friend chicken, and general dishes. Have tried their bibimbap and bulgogi - both good (just not the best). The side dishes (banchan) are great too, and change a bit each time.

Portions are generally quite big, especially the pancakes. Service isn't too friendly but I'll forgive the restaurant for the food.

Terrible service.

We dined here as a table of two. The food arrived very quickly, so we finished our meal within about 40-45 minutes. Our table had a sign stating that the maximum dining time was 90 minutes, so after finishing our food we stayed to chat.

About 5 minutes after we finished eating, a male staff member came over and asked if we were done with our food. We assumed he was simply clearing the table to make us more comfortable, but instead he removed everything, including the water bottle and cups.

At that point, his actions came across as passive-aggressive, and it felt like we were being pressured to leave the restaurant. I was extremely annoyed by this, and after our table had been completely cleared, we decided to leave.

I checked the time and realized we had only been seated for around 50 minutes. When we paid, I asked the cashier downstairs about the dining time limit, and she confirmed that customers are allowed 90 minutes. When I asked why we had been pressured to leave well before that limit, she did apologise to us and ask who was the staff member.

I completely understand that restaurants want to turn over tables and serve more customers. However, pressuring paying customers to leave before the stated dining time limit is unacceptable service.

What made the experience even more disappointing was that other tables around us, who had arrived before us were still seated when we were effectively asked to leave.

Unfortunately, this left a very negative impression and I will never come back or recommend anyone I know to eat there.
Got the ox tail and spicy soup with tripe. There could have been alot more meat especially with the pricing of the dishes. I also wish the flavour was just abit stronger.

misleading menu - Ruined our meal
We visited Hansang Korean Family Restaurant during our trip to Sydney and had a very upsetting experience. We ordered the Traditional Pork Soup hotpot (as seen in my attached image.png), expecting standard pork cuts. No one informed us, nor was it clearly highlighted, that this pot is packed with pig internal organs and parts of the face, including tongue and ears.
When we politely raised this issue, the receptionist dismissively told us that the dish is "common." As tourists who are not Korean, we had no way of knowing this without proper communication from the staff or a clear menu description. The lack of empathy and poor customer service completely ruined our evening. Tourists, beware if you do not eat offal. This might be common for Korean but as international visitors, we shouldn't have to guess what's hidden in our food. A simple warning from the waiter would have prevented this.

There's no atmosphere to speak of, but you're here for the food, let's be real. It's always good and so hearty. From soondae, pork to kimchi pancake, fried chicken, to all its glorious soups, and opportunities to indulge in soju.
